mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction ensure compliance with local building codes for appliance installations in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction prioritizes compliance with all local building codes and regulations for appliance installations in areas like Berkeley, Oakland, and Albany. This includes adherence to electrical, plumbing, gas, and ventilation codes. We conduct thorough checks of all utility connections and structural modifications to ensure they meet required safety and performance standards. Our experienced team and network of licensed professionals stay updated on local requirements, managing necessary permits and inspections to guarantee that your appliance installations are not only functional but also fully compliant and safe.
